note: Seminole County GA publishes parcel maps only through the qPublic (Schneider) viewer, which is behind a Cloudflare challenge and exposes no public ArcGIS REST parcel service. arcgis search for Seminole County/GA parcels found no county FeatureServer or MapServer. The county GIS host gis.seminolecountyga.com did not respond. Commercial downloads (gis.equatorstudios.com) are vendor exports, not county-published files. Neighbouring Houston County AL service does not cover Georgia.
